title: Eval result row
description: One evaluated task case, with the plan §8 field list verbatim (ws-j item 2). Rows are produced per role (plan §9: fixer-worker, review-classifier) and per (model, driver) cell of the eval matrix; comparison-table.schema.json aggregates them.

role.description: Which of the plan §9 roles produced this row.

suite.description: Name of the task suite the case came from (the `name` field of a suite.schema.json document).

case.description: id of the cases[] entry this row scored (links to suite.schema.json case.id). suites/README.md promises one row per case, so rows carry the case id for traceability; optional at schema grain, always emitted by the J2 runner.

model.description: The model id the wire actually served. Served-id decision (2026-09-14): the eval wires request the id the wire serves — glm-5.3-flash on the GLM coding wire, the anthropic-compat wire keeps its served id, deepseek keeps its served id — so the toolkit seam's observed-model check passes green. An observed remap despite the served id is a vendor-behavior documentation entry, not an eval failure.

passed.description: Number of scoring probes that passed for this case.

total.description: Number of scoring probes in this case (at least one).

costUSD.description: Per-invocation cost in USD, or null. DD-9 (2026-09-14): subscription lanes have no per-invocation USD, so they report null — a number is never invented for them.

costBasis.description: Optional basis of a non-null costUSD, mirroring the toolkit's WorkerResult.costBasis: "billed" is provider-reported spend, "modeled" is an estimate from published rates. It exists so a modeled number is never silently reported as actual spend, and it is forbidden when costUSD is null (DD-9).

wallTimeMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the invocation in milliseconds.

tokens.description: Token usage as observed at the toolkit seam (ADR-0001 usage shape): input/output required; cache and reasoning counters optional, all integers >= 0.

runId.description: Identifier shared by all rows produced in the same eval run.
